title: looking for alien kind of exterior tileset for my vx ace game

posts.author: slungus_7
posts.body: im working on my game and i have a part where the player travels to the "future" but slowly realizes it an alien planet i have an alien kind of nature tileset (by psychronic on itch.io) but i cant have an alien planet without buildings for the inhabitants to live any size will work if the creator of the tileset is fine with it being resized for other rpg makers but i would prefer rpg maker vx ace rtp styled tilesets
